items.text: I'm glad you liked The Power. I've been meaning to explore more non-fiction books, do you think The Power of Habit by Charles Duhigg would be a good fit for me? I've been trying to change some habits lately, and I'm interested in learning more about the science behind it.

I'm also interested in exploring more non-fiction books, especially ones that can help me improve my daily habits and productivity. Do you have any recommendations on books that can help me with time management and goal setting?

I actually have "Atomic Habits" by James Clear, and I've been reading it slowly, taking notes, and reflecting on my own habits and behaviors. It's been really helpful in keeping me accountable and seeing my progress over time.

I've found the habit stacking technique to be really helpful. I've also been using the implementation intention strategy, where I specify when and where I'll perform a new habit. For example, I've been trying to start a meditation habit, so I've committed to meditating for 10 minutes every morning right after I brush my teeth. It's been really helpful in making the habit stick.

I've also been using a habit tracker app to track my progress. It's been really motivating to see my streaks and watch my habits grow over time. I've also been reflecting on my habits and behaviors by writing in a journal. It's been helpful in identifying patterns and areas where I need to improve.
